scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npx prisma db push --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && node server/src/index.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
